full_name: Sky Hopinka | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Simon Fraser University
bio: Sky Hopinka is a Ho-Chunk Nation national and descendent of the Pechanga Band of Luiseño Indians. An associate professor of film, video, and animation at Simon Fraser University, he is a video artist and language teacher. He studied and taught Chinuk Wawa, a language indigenous to the Lower Columbia River Basin.
